_comment: Zero-Token Sovereign MCP topology (Phase Z2b). Merge the entries you want into your project .mcp.json or the Docker MCP Gateway. EGRESS MODEL: reads in, data-out blocked. Servers that touch your CODE run with --network none (your code physically cannot leave); only Fetch/Context7 get the internet, restricted to an allowlist; the exec-sandbox is --network none. Pin every third-party image by @sha256 digest (replace PIN_ME) before use.

citadel-retrieval._role: OUR trusted zero-token retrieval server. Runs natively (reaches host Ollama + Redis directly); never_call_claude, read-only. No container needed — it only talks to localhost.

filesystem._role: Reference server, touches your code → NO EGRESS. Read-only bind mount.

git._role: Reference server, reads your repo → NO EGRESS.

memory._role: Reference knowledge-graph memory → NO EGRESS (local KG only).

fetch._role: The ONLY server that needs the internet. Runs on the egress-allowlist network; everything not on the allowlist is dropped. Read-only (GET).

_exec_sandbox._role: Where Z4/Z5 run+verify code. Always --network none, ephemeral (--rm), no host mounts beyond a scoped worktree. A prompt-injected reverse shell has nowhere to go.
